=Do the following for the stock with ticker symbol: {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.Ticker }}

Here is financial data to help you do the following research. It has 3 months of past prices, income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement of past 4 years: {{ $('get_stock_data.py Basic').item.json.stdout }}

Here is 10 articles showing recent news of the company. You can use this for sentiment anaylsis as I describe below: {{ $json.cleaned_news_data }}

Do a short technical analysis of the stock. Use previous stock price data of the last 3 months, and use knowledge of chart patterns, and all types of technical indicators, volume analysis, and more to determine the outlook of the stock price in the next month, quarter, and year



Next, do a sentimental analysis of the stock. Look at the recent news of the company, and the public opinion. In addition, take into account the current market conditions. Then use this information to potentially alter your outlook on the stock price in the next month, quarter, and year.



Analyze and research through the following things before you give your response. These things should be used to potentially alter the outlook on the stock price in the next month, quarter, and year.



1) Industry Potential

2) Product Potential

3) Competition

4) Business Model

5) Leadership

6) Financials of the company, including balance sheet, cash flow statement, income statement of previous months and years, and P/E ratio and EPS.

7) How profitable the company is, and how good it is at minimizing debt

8) Size of audience/market

9) Valuation of the company



Response Format (this is how the model should respond, no extra information than what is specified):

Company: put company and ticker symbol

BSH: put either BUY, HOLD, or SELL based off all the analysis and information you went over

Investment Rating: out of 10, dont explain, just put the rating based off all the analysis and information you went over. (Example: 6/10)

Risk Rating: out of 10, dont explain, just put the rating based off all the analysis and information you went over. (Example: 6/10)

Next Month Outlook: put POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, don't explain, just put the rating based off all the analysis and information you went over.

Next Quarter Outlook: put POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, don't explain, just put the rating based off all the analysis and information you went over

Next Year Outlook: put POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, don't explain, just put the rating based off all the analysis and information you went over

do not put anything else besides that response format. do not expand on anything else. do not put more information.

Remember to only keep it to that short response format I provided. Do not put any other word or information.
